name: Worn Gear Starter Family v1
review_note: Direct Codex review vs the approved concept board: silhouettes 9.5 (bearded hatchet, crescent pick, fullered sword, leaf dagger, recurved stave, plank shield all land); shape hierarchy 9.0; material separation 9.0 after the copper-bronze/haft-oak/leather split; defining features 8.9 (fuller, drooped guard, proud bit edge, repair band, riveted rim + faceted boss present; hatchet beard slightly shallower than concept); gameplay-camera readability 9.2; animation-readiness 9.0 (grip-origin contract, conventional blade axes); family consistency 9.3.
improve: Deepen the hatchet beard notch and consider a subtle second wood tone on the bow stave in a later tier pass
